_readme: HAND-WRITTEN every iteration by Claude (or the agent doing the build): what Claude is LOOKING FOR this version. Only put questions here that ONLY the user can answer (real GPU frame rate, phone feel, 'does X look right'). Then run: node tools/build-claude-check.mjs --version <Vnnn> --categories "<names>" . kinds: text | yesno | choice (needs choices) | number. device: any | desktop | phone | touch | gpu.
summary: V185: OmniStar boot screen (rolling 4->5->12-point star, star field) and OmniOS branding

asks.question: How smooth is the OmniStar boot animation on your phone and on your real GPU machine (roll, landing, spin, star field)?
asks.why: I only saw it in software-rendered Chromium; the roll and spin are meant to survive a busy main thread but I could not test a real device.

asks.question: Does the star's landing position after the word 'OmniStar' look right (gap, vertical centre)?
asks.why: The slot is measured from the real text width, but only judged on one system font; your device font may shift the baseline.

asks.question: Do the stars feel balanced between enterprise-grade and gaming-console?
asks.why: You wanted restrained but alive. Say in the message if it needs fewer / more stars, stronger pull, or no faint lines.

asks.question: Is there anything still saying OmniReality that should say OmniOS?
asks.why: I changed the tab title, boot screen, Global Bar logo tooltip, dump and user guide; I kept code names, OmniRealityGrid panels and the concept word Reality.

asks.question: Real-GPU frame rate (fps) with the all-emoji demo store loaded and open?
asks.why: Every frame rate so far came from software rendering at about 1 fps; I cannot tell if the 1,914-emoji store or the shelf layouts are fast enough on a real GPU.

asks.question: How does the store feel on your phone (opening, paging, the exchange sheet, pinning a node)?
asks.why: The store and the Inspector block were only measured in a desktop browser with a narrow window. Add any detail in the message box.

asks.question: Is this Claude Check panel comfortable to use on your phone (no sideways scroll, buttons easy to hit)?
asks.why: It is new in V184 and was only checked at 390px in a desktop browser; the whole feedback loop depends on it being usable where you test.

asks.question: Did any ordinary node behaviour regress after V183 changed OmniNode / OmniInspector (create, select, edit, group, duplicate, delete, save and reload)?
asks.why: V183 touched the shared node and Inspector code; the automated suites pass but only a hands-on session shows a changed feel. If yes, name the action in the message.

knownIssues: The boot animation was never judged on a real GPU, a real phone or with touch (software-GL Chromium only).
While main.js loads, the star's roll / spin keep running off the main thread, but the 4-to-5 and 5-to-12 point morphs and the star field need the main thread and can stall during long tasks.
OmniReality is still the name of an OmniBrowserSpace layer and of OmniRealityGrid* code; only user-facing product text became OmniOS.
The newest Unicode 16/17 emoji may not draw on a device whose emoji font is older; the all-emoji demo draws them on demand only.
d3 loads from jsDelivr in the real app; first load on a real network was never tested.
Objects near [200, 50, 300] can intersect a store moved there; there is no collision or warning.
The all-emoji store uses about 837 KB of the roughly 5 MB localStorage budget (an IndexedDB store would remove the limit).
The arbitrage guard only blocks continuing a loop within 10 minutes of your own buy log; it ignores fees and a second account.
Only the current identity's stores can be listed or entered; a pin from a store that is not active cannot be reached from the UI.
